```artifact
Feature: Doorstop Requirements Management Functionalities

  Scenario: Provide unique and permanent identifiers to linkable sections of text
    Given a document with multiple sections
    When a new section is created
    Then the system shall assign a unique and permanent identifier to the section

  Scenario: Support formatting within linkable text
    Given a linkable text section
    When formatting options (e.g., bold, italic, underline) are applied
    Then the formatted text shall be preserved and linkable

  Scenario: Support the storage of external requirements assets
    Given an external requirements asset (e.g., PDF, Word document)
    When the asset is uploaded to Doorstop
    Then the asset shall be stored and accessible via a unique identifier

  Scenario: Import content from other requirements management tools
    Given content from a supported external tool (e.g., JIRA, Confluence)
    When the import process is initiated
    Then the content shall be accurately imported into Doorstop

  Scenario: Export content to interact with common text/document tools
    Given a set of requirements within Doorstop
    When the export process to a common tool (e.g., Markdown, HTML) is triggered
    Then the exported content shall be compatible and usable by the target tool

  Scenario: Provide a way to view requirements as a document
    Given a collection of requirements
    When the user requests a document view
    Then the requirements shall be presented in a formatted document layout

  Scenario: Provide a way to view document items interactively
    Given a document with multiple items (e.g., tables, lists)
    When the user interacts with an item (e.g., expands a table)
    Then the item shall respond with the expected interactive behavior

  Scenario: Provide the capability to baseline versions of requirements
    Given a set of requirements
    When a baseline version is created
    Then the requirements shall be frozen at that point in time and distinguishable from future versions

  Scenario Outline: Validate unique identifier generation (normal, edge, invalid)
    Given a new section is to be created
    When the identifier generation process is executed
    Then the identifier shall be <identifier_type>
    Examples:
      | identifier_type |
      | unique          |
      | permanent       |
      | edge_case_long_text |
      | invalid_format  |

  Scenario Outline: Validate formatting preservation within linkable text (normal, edge, invalid)
    Given a linkable text section with <formatting_type>
    When formatting is applied
    Then the formatting shall be preserved
    Examples:
      | formatting_type |
      | bold            |
      | italic          |
      | underline       |
      | invalid_format  |

  Scenario Outline: Validate external asset storage (normal, edge, invalid)
    Given an external asset of type <asset_type>
    When the asset is uploaded
    Then the asset shall be stored
    Examples:
      | asset_type |
      | PDF        |
      | Word       |
      | invalid_format |

  Scenario Outline: Validate import from external tools (normal, edge, invalid)
    Given content from a tool of type <tool_type>
    When the import process is initiated
    Then the content shall be imported correctly
    Examples:
      | tool_type |
      | JIRA      |
      | Confluence|
      | invalid_tool |

  Scenario Outline: Validate export to common tools (normal, edge, invalid)
    Given a set of requirements
    When the export to a tool of type <tool_type> is triggered
    Then the export shall be compatible
    Examples:
      | tool_type |
      | Markdown  |
      | HTML      |
      | invalid_format |

  Scenario Outline: Validate baseline versioning (normal, edge, invalid)
    Given a set of requirements
    When a baseline version is created at <baseline_point>
    Then the requirements shall be frozen at that point
    Examples:
      | baseline_point |
      | initial        |
      | mid_project    |
      | invalid_point  |
```
